citations.claim: first violating step energy -125.75 violates allowed drift 39.73 from E0 -82.6
step before violation already drifting, distance 0.52
earlier step energy still near initial, before close approach

counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.0331 to 0.005, same steps/G/masses/positions - provides finer time resolution to resolve close encounter, eliminates energy violation

explanation: Shrunk 2-body scenario has high G and large dt (0.033) with bodies starting 2.3 apart moving toward close encounter. By step 8 distance 0.52 and by step 9 distance 0.15 with very deep potential (-1054) and kinetic ~929. Leapfrog substeps (19-25) insufficient to resolve steep softened gravity at close approach, causing energy drift from -82.6 to -125.7 exceeding allowed 39.73. Reducing dt to 0.005 with same steps conserves energy, confirming numerical integration error, not physics.
vision_note: Steps 6-7 show two separate blue bodies moving closer together on the left side. By step 8 they overlap strongly and by step 9 they appear merged into a single mass, indicating an unresolved close encounter.
